subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public Plugin SDK policy-facts contract should before_tool_call expose for tool security decisions: enum actionCategory, composable capability flags, inputProvenance/externalContent/requester origin, or a coordinated versioned object?
rationale: This defines what installed plugins can learn and enforce about user/session provenance and tool intent, and overlaps multiple open security-policy efforts that could otherwise create divergent public contracts.

options.title: Approve coordinated policy facts
options.body: Define one additive hook facts object covering action/capability taxonomy, safe provenance, requester origin, docs, SDK baseline, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Land narrower provenance first
options.body: Treat PR #91800 or #96211 as the first narrow step and keep action/category descriptors tracked separately until the taxonomy is stable.

options.title: Defer to Security Matrix design
options.body: Pause this hook API until Security Matrix and tool descriptor proposals define the canonical facts model.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated policy facts
recommendation.body: Define one additive hook facts object covering action/capability taxonomy, safe provenance, requester origin, docs, SDK baseline, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The hook contract history and current public Plugin SDK surface most directly point to vincentkoc for deciding the stable hook shape with security reviewers.
